name: tbox (coroutine switch)
baseline: Boost.Context (boost), libco (Tencent), libgo(boost), libmill, libtask, Go, cloudwu coroutine, acl libfiber
workload: 10,000,000 coroutine switches among 2 and 1000 coroutines, in the benchbox 'switch' test, on macOS x86_64 and on ArchLinux i386 and LinuxMint x86_64 under VirtualBox.
claimed_speedup: LinuxMint x86_64, 1000 coroutines: tbox 400 ms vs boost 894 ms vs libco 2288 ms for 10M switches (derived from page data: about 2.2x vs boost, 5.7x vs libco). 2 coroutines: tbox 187 ms vs boost 199 ms vs libco 687 ms (about 1.06x vs boost, 3.7x vs libco; libmill 145 ms is faster). Tbox repo says its co/context is based on boost context optimized.
hardware: VirtualBox VMs (LinuxMint x86_64, ArchLinux i386) and macOS x86_64; CPU model not stated
tradeoffs: Coroutine switch is one module of a glib-like C library (tbox); needs xmake or its build to use; stackful and stackless coroutines; assembly per architecture (x86, x86_64, ARM, ARM64).
caveats: First-party benchmark (benchbox by the same author). No compiler, flags or CPU model stated, VM runs. Lead over boost is marginal with 2 coroutines and libmill is faster there. Benchmark source is benchbox src (xmake coroutine -n switch).
found_via: WebSearch: 'tbox coroutine context switch assembly faster than libco benchmark tboox' then github.com/tboox/benchbox/wiki/switch

name: libmill
baseline: Boost.Context (boost) and libco in the same shootout
workload: Same benchbox switch test: 10,000,000 switches between 2 coroutines.
claimed_speedup: LinuxMint x86_64, 2 coroutines: libmill 145 ms vs boost 199 ms vs libco 687 ms (derived from page data: about 1.4x vs boost, 4.7x vs libco). With 1000 coroutines libmill is 1014 ms vs boost 894 ms, i.e. not faster.
hardware: VirtualBox VM (LinuxMint x86_64); CPU model not stated
tradeoffs: Go-style concurrency API in C (goroutines, channels); coroutines use setjmp/longjmp style switching; superseded by libdill by the same author.
caveats: Win is only in the 2-coroutine row; loses to boost and tbox at 1000 coroutines. Benchmark run by the tbox author in VMs, no flags or CPU model. Repo claims no performance numbers itself. Last commit date not confirmed.
found_via: Same benchbox switch wiki page surfaced via tbox search
